title: Aural Rehab for Adult CI Outcomes
official: A Phase I, Single-Center Study of the Effects of Aural Rehabilitation Protocols on Adult Cochlear Implant Outcomes
summary: This study will compare two different types of aural rehabilitation schedules (computer-based auditory training vs computer based auditory training and clinician guided training) for adult cochlear implant (CI) users to determine the effect of rehabilitation type on speech perception, hearing related-quality of life, and CI management skills.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be at least 18 years of age at the time of cochlear implantation.
* Receive pre- and post-CI care at the NYU Langone Health Cochlear Implant Center.
* Have bilateral hearing loss, with at least moderate to profound hearing loss in both ears.
* Be able to participate in follow-up visits, either in person or via synchronous telehealth, and to use an app-based training platform (ReDi).
* Be English-speaking or have native-like English proficiency.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Has significant cognitive impairment or a medical disability that precludes informed consent or reliable participation or develops such impairment during the study period.
* Has pre-lingual or long-term (\>20 years) severe to profound hearing loss
* Is undergoing cochlear implantation for single-sided deafness.
* Is undergoing revision CI surgery.
* Is younger than 18 years of age.
